name: Ichijou Kaori
source:
Apartment resident. She is an active nurse.

Her husband as been deceased for 7 years and is still stubbornly faithful to him, but recently her son has reached the age where he is becoming more and more aware of the opposite sex. 

She is very concerned that her son has recently reached the age where he has become aware of the opposite sex and sometimes looks at her with a passionate gaze.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532785]Getchu[/url]]
